text:
Hannah: FYI - VendorPay ran a trial rebate in Nov that got applied then pulled back after billing. Vendor invoice for reimbursement hit our mailbox after the reversal. Need quick decision for Nov close: record vendor accrual or treat as deferral adjustment? Total rebate $29,140.

Diego: Are these customer-facing discounts we need to absorb or third-party reimbursements?

Hannah: Third-party reimbursements (VendorPay). Applied 2024-11-16, reversal 2024-11-19, vendor invoice dated 2024-11-22. Affected invoices = 9. Quick split below:
acct-X1: $12,500 - annual prepaid (8 months left)
acct-Y2: $7,140 - usage/overage (recognized)
acct-Z3: $9,500 - quarterly prepaid (3 months left)
TOTAL: $29,140

Rowan: High level policy: usage/overage credits that offset recognized revenue -> reverse immediately. Prepaid credits -> record as revenue deferral and amortize across remaining term. If vendor invoice exists and payment ETA is within ~60 days, record a vendor accrual to avoid P&L timing mismatch. Anything >$20k needs FP&A notified.

Hannah: Vendor PO VP-3309. Vendor email confirms reimbursement; ETA payment 2024-12-10. I'll attach the vendor email to the JE packet.

Diego: Draft JE for review:
Dr Revenue Deferral (GL 2120) 29,140
  Cr Vendor Accrual (GL 2220) 29,140
Then immediate reversal for usage portion:
Dr Revenue (GL 4010) 7,140
  Cr Revenue Deferral (GL 2120) 7,140
Notes: amortize $21,999 across remaining months by account (acct-X1 and acct-Z3) using per-account schedules.

Rowan: Small detail - use the actual remaining term months per account (don't pro-rate by start date). Include per-invoice ID mapping and a one-line memo on the vendor confirmation. I'll need the amort schedule CSV before routing.

accounting-bot: Reminder - month close lock 2024-11-30 23:59 PST. Please submit adjustments by 2024-11-29 EOD for review.

Diego: I'll prepare the JE, amort schedule and tag memo "VendorPay rebate reversal - Nov24". Routing: finance-leads@redwood.com and cc accounting@redwood.com. FP&A-Bot: auto-notify?

FP&A-Bot: Auto-notice triggered for amount >$20k. Please include vendor invoice, PO VP-3309, per-invoice mapping, and amortization schedule in submission. Approval required from Finance Lead before posting.

Hannah: Thanks - uploading docs to Confluence now and will paste the link when done. :thumbsup:
